columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Transaction identifier primary key.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: User identifiable transaction number.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch partition identifier. Combination of REQUEST_ID and BATCH_ID is unique

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of order management transaction. Possible values are ORA_CREATE, ORA_AMEND, ORA_CLOSE.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_ID
columns.description: Sales order identifier in Order Management.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_LINE_ID
columns.description: Sales order line identifier in Order Management.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_FULFILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: Fulfillment line identifier in Order Management.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Subscription identifier in Subscription Management.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Subscription Product identifier in Subscription Management.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_STATUS
columns.description: Current status of the transaction. Possible values are NEW, PENDING, PROCESSED, ERROR, ONHOLD.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_REF_ID
columns.description: Subscription identifier of the referenced product from the order document references.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_REF_ID
columns.description: Subscription Product identifier of the referenced product from the order document references.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REPROCESS_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the transaction can be reprocessed.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: The subscription profile id from the sales order or the defaulting rules in Subscription Configuration.

columns.name: GROUPING_RULE_SET_ID
columns.description: Grouping Rule Set Identifier

columns.name: GROUPING_RULE_NUMBER
columns.description: Grouping Rule Public Unique Identifier

columns.name: GROUPING_HASH_KEY
columns.description: Grouping Hash Key
